<![CDATA[import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

// The live route and download share the original self-contained document.
export function GET() {
  const html = readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "downloads", "rooted.html"), "utf8");
  return new Response(html, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } });
}
]]>

<![CDATA[<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#f5f3e8" />
  <meta name="description" content="ROOTED is a thoughtful plant-care companion. Make room for greener routines, gentle reminders and every new leaf." />
  <title>ROOTED — A little greener, every day.</title>
  <style>
    :root{--cream:#f5f3e8;--paper:#f9f7ed;--ink:#203725;--ink2:#314a37;--moss:#6f8768;--sage:#dce4cf;--sage-dark:#c5d3b6;--line:#ccd2bf;--clay:#b97857;--ease:cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1);--sans:'Avenir Next','Inter','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;--serif:'Iowan Old Style','Baskerville','Palatino Linotype',Georgia,serif}
    *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:85px}
    body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:16px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:clip}
    ::selection{background:#aec9a0;color:#183221}
    a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
    button,input{font:inherit}
    button{cursor:pointer}
    button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,[tabindex]:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #a77848;outline-offset:4px}
    img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
    svg{display:block}
    .sr-only{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;padding:0!important;margin:-1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border:0!important}
    .eyebrow{font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:.22em;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
    .eyebrow::before{content:'';width:24px;height:1px;background:currentColor;display:inline-block;opacity:.65}
    .serif{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.067em}
    .section-width{width:min(1320px,calc(100% - 104px));margin-inline:auto}
    .line-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;border:1px solid var(--ink);padding:15px 24px;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px;font-weight:650;transition:background .3s,color .3s,transform .2s}
    .line-button:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
    .button{position:relative;display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:17px;isolation:isolate;background:var(--ink);color:#fffdf5;border:1px solid var(--ink);padding:18px 27px;border-radius:999px;min-height:54px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;transition:background .2s,box-shadow .3s,scale .17s;will-change:transform}
    .button:hover{background:#36533a;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #263f2b28}.button:active,.line-button:active{scale:.97}
    .button::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 22%,#ffffff3e 50%,transparent 78%);transform:translateX(-145%);transition:transform .7s var(--ease);pointer-events:none}
    .button:hover::after{transform:translateX(145%)}
    .button--light{background:#eeeada;color:var(--ink);border-color:#eeeada}.button--light:hover{background:white}
    .scroll-progress{position:fixed;z-index:100;top:0;left:0;height:3px;background:#7b9c71;width:0%;pointer-events:none;transition:width .07s linear}
    .header{position:absolute;z-index:50;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:100px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 max(52px,calc((100vw - 1320px)/2));gap:36px;transition:background .35s,box-shadow .35s,height .35s}
    .header.is-scrolled{position:fixed;height:76px;background:#f6f4e8ed;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #b4c0aa7d}
    .brand{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:34px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:-.065em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap}
    .brand svg{width:29px;transform:rotate(-13deg)}
    .nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(17px,3.3vw,50px);margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
    .nav-links a{font-size:14px;font-weight:540;position:relative;padding:12px 0}
    .nav-links a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:100%;bottom:7px;height:1px;background:var(--ink);transition:right .4s var(--ease)}
    .nav-links a:hover::after{right:0}
    .header-cta{min-height:47px;padding:12px 22px;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}
    .menu-button{display:none;width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:50%;background:#f6f5e7d9;color:var(--ink);align-items:center;justify-content:center}
    .menu-button svg{width:20px;height:20px}
    .mobile-nav{display:none}
    /* HERO: background is the supplied clean, text-free approved production asset. */
    .hero{min-height:760px;height:100svh;max-height:1040px;position:relative;isolation:isolate;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;background:var(--cream)}
    .hero__art{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;background:#f0eedf url('data:image/webp;base64,') center center/cover no-repeat;will-change:transform}
    .hero__wash{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f4f1e30b 0%,#f4f1e300 64%);pointer-events:none}
    .hero__inner{width:min(1320px,calc(100% - 104px));margin:100px auto 0;position:relative;z-index:2}
    .hero__copy{width:min(50%,635px);padding-bottom:18px}
    .hero__eyebrow{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.21em;margin-bottom:22px}
    .hero h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(62px,6.15vw,105px);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.076em;margin:0 0 28px;text-wrap:balance;font-weight:500}
    .hero h1 span{display:block;overflow:hidden}
    .hero h1 span em{font-style:normal;display:block;transform:translate3d(0,110%,0);animation:heroWords 1.2s var(--ease) forwards}
    .hero h1 span:nth-child(2) em{animation-delay:.14s}.hero h1 span:nth-child(3) em{animation-delay:.28s}
    @keyframes heroWords{to{transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}}
    .hero__description{max-width:420px;font-size:clamp(16px,1.35vw,20px);line-height:1.48;letter-spacing:-.018em;margin:0 0 31px;color:#2c382c}
    .hero__actions{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .hero__note{position:absolute;bottom:35px;left:max(52px,calc((100vw - 1320px)/2));font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:650}
    .hero__scroll{position:absolute;bottom:32px;right:max(52px,calc((100vw - 1320px)/2));font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px}
    .hero__scroll svg{height:35px;width:17px;animation:scrollHint 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
    @keyframes scrollHint{0%,100%{transform:translateY(-3px)}50%{transform:translateY(6px)}}
    .ticker{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink);color:#dce6d3;padding:23px 0;white-space:nowrap}
    .ticker__track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:ticker 34s linear infinite}
    .ticker__set{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:64px;padding-right:64px;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.23em}
    .ticker__set svg{width:20px;height:20px;stroke:#b8d0a3;fill:none;stroke-width:1.5}
    @keyframes ticker{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
    .intro{min-height:780px;padding:160px 0 120px;position:relative;background:#f8f6ec;overflow:hidden}
    .intro__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .7fr;align-items:center;gap:10vw}
    .intro h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(62px,6.6vw,108px);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.072em;line-height:.94;margin:25px 0 0;max-width:810px}
    .intro h2 i{font-weight:400;color:#869d79}
    .intro__aside{padding-top:105px}
    .intro__aside p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.75;max-width:380px;color:#506350}
    .intro__rule{width:100%;height:1px;background:#c5d1c1;margin:40px 0 22px}
    .intro__stat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}
    .intro__stat strong{font:400 66px/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.06em}.intro__stat span{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.15em}
    .intro__illustration{position:absolute;width:270px;bottom:-35px;left:42%;opacity:.25;pointer-events:none}
    .intro__illustration path[data-draw]{stroke-dasharray:800;stroke-dashoffset:800;transition:stroke-dashoffset .1s linear}
    /* Scroll story: 390svh provides approximately one full viewport per feature plus breathing room. */
    .story{height:390svh;min-height:2450px;position:relative;background:#e5eadd}
    .story__sticky{position:sticky;top:0;height:100svh;min-height:670px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:94px max(52px,calc((100vw - 1320px)/2)) 26px;overflow:hidden}
    .story__top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding-bottom:20px;border-bottom:1px solid #afbba9}
    .story__top .eyebrow{font-size:11px}.story__top aside{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase}
    .story__body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(0,.95fr);gap:clamp(52px,8vw,130px);min-height:0;flex:1;align-items:center;padding:27px 0 24px}
    .story__frame{position:relative;align-self:stretch;max-height:675px;min-height:470px;isolation:isolate;border-radius:180px 180px 21px 21px;background:#d3dfcc;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 25px 65px #314d2b18}
    .story__frame::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border:1px solid #ffffff70;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;z-index:6}
    .story__img{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:0;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0);transition:clip-path 1s var(--ease);background:#dce2cf}
    .story__img img{height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1.1);transition:transform 1.5s var(--ease)}
    .story__img.is-active{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);z-index:2}
    .story__img.is-active img{transform:scale(1.015)}
    .story__img.is-prev{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);z-index:1}
    .story__img--landscape img{object-position:63% center}
    .story__frame-tag{z-index:8;position:absolute;bottom:23px;left:24px;border-radius:999px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);background:#f3f5ebdf;border:1px solid #ffffff90;padding:11px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase}
    .story__frame-tag::before{content:'';height:6px;width:6px;background:#69976b;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #8cba8b30}
    .story__content{position:relative;align-self:stretch;display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
    .story__head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:15px;margin-bottom:22px}
    .story__big-num{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(78px,8vw,132px);line-height:.75;letter-spacing:-.08em;color:#a6bda2}
    .story__head-label{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:750}
    .story__panel-stack{position:relative;height:clamp(225px,34vh,315px)}
    .story__panel{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,42px,0) rotateX(-8deg);transform-origin:center bottom;transition:opacity .5s ease,transform .85s var(--ease)}
    .story__panel.is-active{opacity:1;transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotateX(0);pointer-events:auto}
    .story__panel h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(47px,4.6vw,80px);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.072em;line-height:.97;margin:0 0 24px;max-width:540px}
    .story__panel p{font-size:clamp(15px,1.1vw,18px);line-height:1.7;color:#576a55;max-width:390px;margin:0}
    .story__selector{display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin-top:20px;border-top:1px solid #b8c7b2}
    .story__step{background:none;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #b8c7b2;text-align:left;padding:16px 7px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#6e8370;transition:padding-left .3s,color .3s}
    .story__step .index{opacity:.75;font-size:10px;margin-right:12px}.story__step.is-active{padding-left:18px;color:var(--ink);background:#f6f8f047}.story__step.is-active .story__arrow{transform:rotate(-45deg)}
    .story__arrow{transition:transform .4s var(--ease)}
    .story__footer{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid #b8c7b2;padding-top:17px}
    .story__footer-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
    .story__progress{display:flex;gap:5px;flex:1}.story__progress span{height:4px;border-radius:99px;background:#bcccb8;flex:1;overflow:hidden}.story__progress span i{display:block;background:var(--ink);height:100%;width:0;transition:width .1s linear}
    .story-mobile{display:none}
    .story__leaf-scribble{position:absolute;right:0;top:7%;width:62px;opacity:.32;animation:leafSway 6s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:bottom center}
    @keyframes leafSway{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-7deg)}50%{transform:rotate(9deg)}}
    /* Interactive care lab */
    .lab{background:#f8f6ed;padding:135px 0 155px;overflow:hidden}
    .lab__intro{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:42px;margin-bottom:70px}
    .lab h2{font:400 clamp(57px,6.3vw,94px)/.97 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.075em;max-width:850px;margin:22px 0 0}
    .lab__intro p{max-width:310px;color:#637361;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 8px}
    .lab__board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1fr;min-height:610px;background:#e6ecdf;border:1px solid #d7dfd1;border-radius:34px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 28px 70px #2a4d2812}
    .lab__visual{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;padding:38px 20px 20px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,#f3f5e8 0%,#e7eddf 64%,#d3e0cb 100%);overflow:hidden}
    .lab__visual::after{content:'';height:20%;position:absolute;bottom:-12%;left:12%;right:12%;background:#97b68a30;filter:blur(30px);pointer-events:none}
    .lab__visual-top{position:absolute;top:33px;left:35px;right:35px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:650;z-index:2}
    .plant-svg{width:min(82%,365px);height:auto;z-index:1;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(8px 22px 20px #57725524)}
    .plant-svg .stem{stroke:#3c6a43;fill:none;stroke-width:7;stroke-linecap:round}
    .plant-svg .leaf-shape{fill:#63895d;stroke:#366443;stroke-width:1;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:bottom center;transition:transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,1.45,.36,1),fill .7s}
    .plant-svg .leaf-shape.alt{fill:#7b9f72}.plant-svg .leaf-shape.sleeping{transform:scale(.6) rotate(-8deg);fill:#a4b99c}
    .plant-svg .pot{fill:#b97750}.plant-svg .pot-rim{fill:#d2956c}
    .lab__ambient{position:absolute;left:40px;bottom:32px;font:italic 24px var(--serif);color:#7c9c77;z-index:4}
    .lab__app{padding:clamp(26px,4vw,55px);background:#fffef9;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
    .lab__app-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:33px}
    .lab__app-header .tag{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7d8b77;font-weight:700}
    .lab__app-header strong{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:32px;letter-spacing:-.06em}
    .lab__app h3{font:400 43px/.98 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:0 0 10px}
    .lab__app-description{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:#728071;margin:0 0 26px}
    .lab__counter{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:22px}
    .lab__count{font-size:12px;color:#526952}.lab__count strong{font-size:24px;font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400}
    .lab__meter{height:6px;background:#e8ece2;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;flex:1;max-width:220px}.lab__meter-fill{height:100%;width:0;background:#64896a;transition:width .7s var(--ease)}
    .task-list{display:grid;gap:10px}
    .task{display:flex;gap:15px;align-items:center;text-align:left;padding:16px;border-radius:16px;background:#f5f6f0;border:1px solid #e4e7df;color:var(--ink);transition:background .3s,transform .3s,box-shadow .3s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    .task:hover{background:#eef2e7;transform:translateX(5px);box-shadow:0 8px 18px #20462d0c}.task:active{transform:scale(.985)}
    .task__check{flex:0 0 34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #b9c6b3;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s,transform .4s cubic-bezier(.2,1.8,.4,1)}
    .task__check svg{width:16px;opacity:0;transform:scale(.2);transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s}.task[aria-pressed="true"] .task__check{background:#54775a;border-color:#54775a;transform:rotate(-10deg)}
    .task[aria-pressed="true"] .task__check svg{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);stroke:white}
    .task__text{flex:1;min-width:0}.task__text strong{font-size:14px;font-weight:650;display:block;margin-bottom:5px}.task__text small{font-size:12px;color:#7a8a79}
    .task[aria-pressed="true"] .task__text strong{text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:#8da58b;color:#829482}
    .task__icon{width:24px;color:#7d9b78}
    .lab__app-bottom{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;margin-top:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .lab__app-bottom p{color:#688069;font-size:12px;margin:0;max-width:300px}
    .lab__reset{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font-size:11px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
    .lab__pulse{position:absolute;width:15px;height:15px;background:#89b48688;border-radius:50%;left:30px;top:50%;pointer-events:none;animation:wateringPulse .7s ease-out forwards}
    @keyframes wateringPulse{to{transform:translate(-20px,-35px) scale(5);opacity:0}}
    /* Guide section deliberately different from the pinned storytelling layout. */
    .guides{background:#e5e8da;padding:125px 0 145px}
    .guides__head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr .55fr;gap:70px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:52px}
    .guides h2{font:400 clamp(55px,6vw,94px)/.98 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.072em;margin:20px 0 0}
    .guides__head p{line-height:1.7;color:#5b6e5c;max-width:360px;margin-bottom:8px}
    .guide-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
    .guide-card{background:#f8f8f0;position:relative;text-align:left;border:1px solid #d4ddcb;padding:27px 26px 32px;min-height:365px;border-radius:19px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;transition:transform .7s var(--ease),box-shadow .5s,border-color .3s;transform-style:preserve-3d;will-change:transform}
    .guide-card:hover{box-shadow:0 20px 36px #37503b16;border-color:#afc4ab}
    .guide-card__top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;gap:12px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.17em;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase}
    .guide-card__art{width:100%;height:155px;margin:20px 0 13px;display:grid;place-items:center}
    .guide-card__art svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
    .guide-card h3{font:400 clamp(28px,2.5vw,36px)/1.05 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:0 0 13px}
    .guide-card p{line-height:1.55;font-size:13px;margin:0;color:#657564;max-width:260px}
    .guide-card__arrow{position:absolute;bottom:26px;right:25px;transition:transform .3s}.guide-card:hover .guide-card__arrow{transform:translate(4px,-4px)}
    .guide-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(250px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,50%),#85ac7c30,transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .32s;pointer-events:none}.guide-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
    .guide-card:nth-child(2){background:#d2ddc7}.guide-card:nth-child(3){background:#f0e9db}
    .guide-card .draw-line{stroke-dasharray:500;stroke-dashoffset:500;transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.6s var(--ease)}
    .guide-card.is-visible .draw-line{stroke-dashoffset:0}
    /* Wide parallax botanical breath */
    .breath{height:76svh;min-height:530px;max-height:850px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#e2e8d4}
    .breath__img{position:absolute;inset:-12% 0;height:124%;width:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;will-change:transform}
    .breath__wash{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f4f2e6b5 0%,#f4f2e640 42%,transparent 72%)}
    .breath__copy{position:relative;z-index:2;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center}
    .breath__copy h2{font:400 clamp(66px,7vw,126px)/.95 var(--serif);max-width:700px;letter-spacing:-.08em;margin:20px 0 0}
    /* FAQ, no fake testimonials or invented real app-store links */
    .faq{background:#f8f7f0;padding:135px 0 155px}
    .faq__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1fr;gap:11vw}
    .faq h2{font:400 clamp(55px,5.5vw,86px)/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.07em;margin:22px 0 24px}
    .faq__lead{color:#72806d;line-height:1.7;max-width:330px}
    .faq__list{border-top:1px solid #ccd4c6}
    .faq__item{border-bottom:1px solid #ccd4c6}
    .faq__question{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:23px;background:none;border:0;width:100%;padding:25px 0;text-align:left;color:var(--ink);font-size:17px;font-weight:550}
    .faq__plus{display:grid;place-items:center;flex-shrink:0;width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid #becbb9;border-radius:50%;transition:transform .45s var(--ease),background .3s}
    .faq__question[aria-expanded="true"] .faq__plus{transform:rotate(45deg);background:#dce8d6}
    .faq__answer{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .5s var(--ease)}
    .faq__question[aria-expanded="true"]+.faq__answer{grid-template-rows:1fr}
    .faq__answer>div{overflow:hidden}.faq__answer p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.75;color:#5d715d;padding:0 36px 25px 0;margin:0}
    .final{background:#e5ebdb;position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:640px;display:flex;align-items:center}
    .final__image{position:absolute;width:65%;height:100%;right:-2%;top:0;object-fit:cover;object-position:63% center;mix-blend-mode:multiply;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,#000 30%);-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,#000 30%)}
    .final__copy{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:90px 0;width:min(1320px,calc(100% - 104px));margin:auto}
    .final h2{font:400 clamp(62px,7vw,120px)/.92 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.075em;margin:22px 0 24px;max-width:780px}
    .final__copy p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.55;max-width:390px;margin-bottom:28px;color:#4e6550}
    .footer{background:var(--ink);color:#eff4e9;padding:70px 0 25px}
    .footer__top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.7fr repeat(3,1fr);gap:40px;padding-bottom:75px}
    .footer .brand{font-size:43px}.footer__brand p{font-size:13px;color:#b5cbb4;max-width:220px;line-height:1.65}
    .footer__heading{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#a9c09f;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:19px}
    .footer__links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:15px}.footer__links a,.footer__links button{color:#e4eee0;font-size:13px;display:block;text-align:left;background:none;border:0;padding:0;width:max-content}
    .footer__links a:hover,.footer__links button:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
    .footer__bottom{border-top:1px solid #ffffff2e;padding-top:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;font-size:11px;color:#b6c5b1}
    /* Dialogs */
    dialog{max-width:min(520px,calc(100% - 28px));width:100%;border:1px solid #d4dfca;padding:0;border-radius:25px;box-shadow:0 40px 100px #06190954;background:#f8f8ef;color:var(--ink)}
    dialog::backdrop{background:#0f241ac9;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
    .modal{padding:39px}.modal__top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.modal__close{border:1px solid #b8c8b6;background:none;width:39px;height:39px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px}
    .modal h2{font:400 49px/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.063em;margin:25px 0 20px}.modal p{font-size:15px;color:#5c6e5b;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 25px}.modal__actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .modal__badge{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.18em;font-weight:750;color:#668369}
    /* Entry motion uses masked vertical movement and scale, not simple opacity fade. */
    .reveal{transform:translate3d(0,55px,0) scale(.965);clip-path:inset(0 0 11% 0);opacity:.9;transition:transform 1.1s var(--ease),clip-path 1s var(--ease),opacity .7s ease;will-change:transform}
    .reveal.is-visible{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1);clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);opacity:1}
    @media(max-width:1100px){.header{padding-inline:36px}.hero__inner,.section-width,.final__copy{width:calc(100% - 72px)}.hero__note{left:36px}.hero__scroll{right:36px}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(64px,7vw,85px)}.story__sticky{padding-inline:36px}.story__body{gap:50px}.intro h2{font-size:77px}.story__panel h3{font-size:60px}}
    @media(max-width:800px){.header{height:76px;padding:0 23px}.header.is-scrolled{height:70px}.brand{font-size:30px}.nav-links,.header-cta{display:none}.menu-button{display:flex;margin-left:auto}.mobile-nav{display:flex;position:fixed;top:70px;left:0;right:0;padding:16px 24px 25px;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;background:#f8f6ebf9;box-shadow:0 18px 28px #12291621;transform:translateY(-18px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s,transform .4s var(--ease)}.mobile-nav.is-open{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);pointer-events:auto}.mobile-nav a,.mobile-nav button{padding:13px 6px;background:none;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #d7e0d1;text-align:left;color:var(--ink);font-size:16px}
      .hero{display:block;height:auto;max-height:none;min-height:0;padding-top:110px}.hero__art{position:relative;z-index:0;display:block;inset:auto;height:55vw;min-height:395px;max-height:610px;margin-top:-26px;background-size:cover;background-position:70% 50%}.hero__wash{display:none}.hero__inner{width:calc(100% - 48px);margin:0 auto;z-index:2}.hero__copy{width:100%;max-width:640px;padding:0}.hero__eyebrow{margin:0 0 19px;font-size:11px}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(61px,10vw,91px);margin-bottom:20px}.hero__description{font-size:17px;margin-bottom:25px;max-width:490px}.hero__note,.hero__scroll{display:none}
      .intro{padding:110px 0;min-height:auto}.intro__grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:35px}.intro__aside{padding:0}.intro h2{font-size:clamp(62px,9vw,94px)}.intro__aside p{max-width:600px}.intro__illustration{left:auto;right:-7%;width:230px}
      .story{height:auto;min-height:0}.story__sticky{position:relative;height:auto;min-height:0;padding:54px 24px 70px}.story__body{display:none}.story__footer{display:none}.story-mobile{display:grid;gap:35px;padding:35px 0 0}.story-mobile__item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid #c1d0bb;padding-bottom:34px}.story-mobile__item img{height:360px;width:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:130px 130px 17px 17px}.story-mobile__item h3{font:400 51px/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:10px 0 15px}.story-mobile__item p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#5d725e}.story-mobile__item .eyebrow{font-size:10px}.story__frame{height:490px;min-height:0;max-height:none;margin-bottom:34px;border-radius:160px 160px 20px 20px}.story__head{margin-top:12px}.story__big-num{font-size:87px}.story__panel-stack{height:auto;min-height:190px}.story__panel{display:none;position:relative;opacity:1;transform:none}.story__panel.is-active{display:block}.story__panel h3{font-size:clamp(55px,8.4vw,72px)}.story__selector{margin-top:25px}.story__footer{margin-top:20px}.story__img{transition:clip-path .8s var(--ease)}
      .lab{padding:105px 0}.lab__intro{display:block}.lab__intro p{margin-top:23px}.lab__board{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lab__visual{min-height:480px}.lab__app{padding:40px}.guides{padding:100px 0}.guides__head{display:block}.guides__head p{margin-top:25px}.guide-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.guide-card:last-child{grid-column:span 2}.breath{height:55svh}.faq__grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:38px}.footer__top{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.footer__brand{grid-column:span 2}.final{min-height:670px}.final__image{width:100%;height:54%;top:auto;bottom:0;right:0;mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 30%);-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#000 30%)}.final__copy{align-self:start;padding:85px 0 330px}
    }
    @media(max-width:520px){.section-width,.hero__inner,.final__copy{width:calc(100% - 42px)}.header{padding:0 21px}.brand{font-size:27px}.hero{padding-top:111px}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(54px,13vw,73px)}.hero__art{min-height:0;height:380px;margin-top:0;background-size:auto 100%;background-position:61% center}.hero__actions{gap:9px}.hero .button,.hero .line-button{min-height:48px;padding:13px 17px;font-size:12px}.ticker{padding:18px 0}.intro{padding:90px 0}.intro h2{font-size:clamp(53px,12vw,73px)}.intro__aside p{font-size:16px}.story__sticky{padding:85px 21px 62px}.story__top aside{display:none}.story-mobile__item{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:22px}.story-mobile__item img{height:420px}.story-mobile__item h3{font-size:52px}.story-mobile__item:nth-child(2){display:flex;flex-direction:column}.story-mobile__item:nth-child(2)>div{align-self:stretch}.story-mobile__item:nth-child(2) img{order:0}.story-mobile__item:nth-child(2)>div{order:1}.story__frame{height:420px}.story__panel h3{font-size:52px}.story__panel-stack{min-height:240px}.story__footer-label{font-size:9px}.lab{padding:87px 0}.lab h2,.guides h2,.faq h2{font-size:clamp(49px,11.5vw,67px)}.lab__intro{margin-bottom:40px}.lab__visual{min-height:370px}.plant-svg{width:290px}.lab__app{padding:26px 19px 32px}.lab__app h3{font-size:38px}.guides{padding:90px 0}.guide-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.guide-card:last-child{grid-column:auto}.guide-card{min-height:330px}.breath{height:590px}.breath__img{object-position:68% center}.breath__wash{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f4f2e8ed,transparent 72%)}.breath__copy{align-items:flex-start;padding-top:74px}.breath__copy h2{font-size:clamp(56px,12vw,74px)}.faq{padding:90px 0}.faq__question{font-size:15px}.final h2{font-size:clamp(57px,12vw,73px)}.final__copy{padding:85px 0 290px}.final__image{height:53%}.footer{padding:58px 0 25px}.footer__top{gap:30px;padding-bottom:55px}.footer__bottom{display:block;line-height:2}.modal{padding:28px}.modal h2{font-size:43px}}
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{scroll-behavior:auto!important;animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.001ms!important}.hero h1 span em{transform:none!important}.reveal{transform:none!important;clip-path:none!important;opacity:1!important}.story__panel{transform:none!important}.story__img img{transform:none!important}}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="scroll-progress" aria-hidden="true" id="scrollProgress"></div>
  <header class="header" id="header">
    <a href="#top" class="brand" aria-label="Rooted — back to top">ROOTED <svg viewBox="0 0 32 34" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M16 31V4M16 18C7 19 5 10 7 4c7 0 11 5 9 14Zm0 6c8-1 11-8 10-14-8 0-13 7-10 14Z" fill="#426a43" stroke="#426a43" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M16 31c-1-11-5-17-10-21m10 16c3-9 7-12 10-15" fill="none" stroke="#f0f5e7" stroke-width="1.1"/></svg></a>
    <nav class="nav-links" aria-label="Primary navigation">
      <a href="#features">Features</a><a href="#guides">Care Guides</a><a href="#demo">The Ritual</a><a href="#questions">FAQs</a>
    </nav>
    <button class="button header-cta magnet" data-download>Explore the App <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>
    <button class="menu-button" aria-label="Open navigation" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="mobileNav" id="menuButton"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7"><path d="M4 8h16M4 16h16"/></svg></button>
    <nav class="mobile-nav" id="mobileNav" aria-label="Mobile navigation"><a href="#features">Features</a><a href="#guides">Care Guides</a><a href="#demo">The Ritual</a><a href="#questions">FAQs</a><button data-download>Explore the App ↗</button></nav>
  </header>

  <main id="top">
    <section class="hero" aria-labelledby="heroTitle">
      <div class="hero__art" aria-hidden="true" id="heroArt"></div><div class="hero__wash" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <div class="hero__inner"><div class="hero__copy">
        <div class="eyebrow hero__eyebrow">Plant care, gently organized</div>
        <h1 id="heroTitle"><span><em>A little</em></span><span><em>greener,</em></span><span><em>every day.</em></span></h1>
        <p class="hero__description">Keep track of watering, light, growth, and routines for every plant you love.</p>
        <div class="hero__actions"><button class="button magnet" data-download>Explore the App <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button><a class="line-button magnet" href="#features">See how it works <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div>
      </div></div>
      <div class="hero__note"><span style="width:6px;height:6px;background:#436948;border-radius:50%"></span> A little more life at home</div>
      <a class="hero__scroll" href="#introduction">Scroll to grow <svg viewBox="0 0 20 42" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 0v38m-6-6 6 6 6-6"/></svg></a>
    </section>

    <div class="ticker" aria-hidden="true"><div class="ticker__track">
      <div class="ticker__set"><span>Make space to grow</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 23V3M12 14C2 16 3 6 4 4c8 1 9 5 8 10Zm0 5c9-2 10-8 9-11-8 0-10 4-9 11Z"/></svg><span>Water with intention</span><span>✦</span><span>Notice the little things</span><span>✦</span><span>Make space to grow</span><span>✦</span></div>
      <div class="ticker__set"><span>Make space to grow</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 23V3M12 14C2 16 3 6 4 4c8 1 9 5 8 10Zm0 5c9-2 10-8 9-11-8 0-10 4-9 11Z"/></svg><span>Water with intention</span><span>✦</span><span>Notice the little things</span><span>✦</span><span>Make space to grow</span><span>✦</span></div>
    </div></div>

    <section class="intro" id="introduction" aria-labelledby="introTitle">
      <div class="section-width intro__grid"><div class="reveal"><div class="eyebrow">The gentler way to grow</div><h2 id="introTitle">Care feels better when it comes <i>naturally.</i></h2></div><div class="intro__aside reveal"><p>More time enjoying your plants. Less time wondering when you last watered them. ROOTED brings the little parts of plant care together, beautifully.</p><div class="intro__rule"></div><div class="intro__stat"><strong>03</strong><span>little rituals<br>for happier greenery</span></div></div></div>
      <svg class="intro__illustration" viewBox="0 0 255 310" fill="none" stroke="#7c9878" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path data-draw d="M119 316C122 224 135 137 116 38M119 265C75 221 40 188 34 132M129 211C179 170 210 134 215 82M116 140C73 99 59 67 61 35M125 247C164 241 206 230 232 195"/><path d="M116 146C84 140 65 121 68 104c35-3 45 22 48 42Zm5 63c20-35 52-36 67-32-4 28-34 41-67 32ZM115 84C79 79 75 55 80 45c25 2 36 21 35 39Zm5 182c-31-5-59-26-61-46 37-5 57 21 61 46Zm14-58c9-37 35-54 51-56 7 30-19 47-51 56Z" fill="#8ba787" stroke="none"/></svg>
    </section>

    <section class="story" id="features" aria-labelledby="storyTitle"><div class="story__sticky" id="storySticky">
      <div class="story__top"><span class="eyebrow">01 / A little care, every day</span><aside>Scroll to explore all three rituals ↓</aside></div>
      <div class="story__body"><div class="story__frame">
        <figure class="story__img is-active" data-story-image="0"><img loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Two ROOTED app screens displaying plant care checklists and a watering calendar" /></figure>
        <figure class="story__img" data-story-image="1"><img loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="ROOTED growth journal app displayed beside a houseplant and gardening notes" /></figure>
        <figure class="story__img story__img--landscape" data-story-image="2"><img loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="A lush group of houseplants in clay pots against a sage botanical backdrop" /></figure>
        <div class="story__frame-tag"><span id="storyImageTag">The daily ritual</span></div>
      </div><div class="story__content">
        <svg class="story__leaf-scribble" viewBox="0 0 80 110" fill="none" stroke="#547c51" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M40 108V11M40 85C8 83 5 57 12 41c29 5 33 27 28 44ZM41 61c30 0 37-24 33-41-27 3-38 20-33 41Z"/></svg>
        <div class="story__head"><span class="story__big-num" id="storyNumber">01</span><span class="story__head-label">Three ways to grow</span></div>
        <div class="story__panel-stack" id="storyTitle">
          <article class="story__panel is-active" data-story-panel="0"><h3>A softer way to remember.</h3><p>Care reminders that feel like a helping hand, not another to-do list. Know who needs water, when, and why.</p></article>
          <article class="story__panel" data-story-panel="1"><h3>Every new leaf has a story.</h3><p>Save little milestones, photos, and notes. Watch your plants change, one patient day at a time.</p></article>
          <article class="story__panel" data-story-panel="2"><h3>Room for every kind of green.</h3><p>From your first pothos to your growing jungle, keep all your plants together in one calm home.</p></article>
        </div>
        <nav class="story__selector" aria-label="Choose feature to explore"><button class="story__step is-active" data-story-step="0" aria-current="step"><span><span class="index">01</span> A gentle routine</span><span class="story__arrow">↗</span></button><button class="story__step" data-story-step="1"><span><span class="index">02</span> Growth journaling</span><span class="story__arrow">↗</span></button><button class="story__step" data-story-step="2"><span><span class="index">03</span> Your little jungle</span><span class="story__arrow">↗</span></button></nav>
      </div></div>
      <div class="story-mobile" aria-label="Three features of ROOTED">
        <article class="story-mobile__item reveal"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," loading="lazy" alt="ROOTED app watering routine and plant calendar"/><div><span class="eyebrow">01 / A gentle routine</span><h3>A softer way to remember.</h3><p>Care reminders that feel like a helping hand, not another to-do list. Know who needs water, when, and why.</p></div></article>
        <article class="story-mobile__item reveal"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," loading="lazy" alt="ROOTED plant growth journal and notes"/><div><span class="eyebrow">02 / Growth journaling</span><h3>Every new leaf has a story.</h3><p>Save little milestones, photos, and notes. Watch your plants change, one patient day at a time.</p></div></article>
        <article class="story-mobile__item reveal"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," loading="lazy" alt="A lush collection of houseplants"/><div><span class="eyebrow">03 / Your little jungle</span><h3>Room for every kind of green.</h3><p>From your first pothos to your growing jungle, keep all your plants together in one calm home.</p></div></article>
      </div>
      <div class="story__footer"><span class="story__footer-label">Your care journey</span><div class="story__progress" aria-hidden="true"><span><i></i></span><span><i></i></span><span><i></i></span></div><span class="story__footer-label" id="storyProgressText">01 / 03</span></div>
    </div></section>

    <section class="lab" id="demo" aria-labelledby="labTitle"><div class="section-width">
      <div class="lab__intro"><div class="reveal"><div class="eyebrow">02 / Try a little care</div><h2 id="labTitle">A small routine.<br>A calmer day.</h2></div><p class="reveal">See how a few thoughtful reminders can make the day feel lighter. Try the interactive routine below.</p></div>
      <div class="lab__board reveal"><div class="lab__visual"><div class="lab__visual-top"><span>LIVE PLANT STUDY</span><span id="plantMood">JUST WAKING UP</span></div>
        <svg class="plant-svg" viewBox="0 0 390 450" role="img" aria-label="Illustrated plant that becomes fuller as demo care tasks are completed"><ellipse cx="198" cy="413" rx="105" ry="15" fill="#a9b69b" opacity=".42"/>
          <path class="stem" d="M194 317Q180 260 196 168Q205 111 176 49"/><path class="stem" d="M193 291Q149 224 106 176"/><path class="stem" d="M193 275Q236 220 272 170"/><path class="stem" d="M189 251Q136 193 118 109"/><path class="stem" d="M194 235Q228 178 243 115"/>
          <path class="leaf-shape" d="M180 160C118 133 91 73 117 55c59 6 76 53 63 105Z"/><path class="leaf-shape alt" d="M201 204c37-80 100-96 122-65-15 57-62 77-122 65Z"/>
          <path class="leaf-shape sleeping" data-leaf-grow d="M156 246C80 229 67 184 87 160c66 7 81 44 69 86Z"/><path class="leaf-shape sleeping alt" data-leaf-grow d="M225 267c36-63 103-80 122-54-18 53-58 65-122 54Z"/>
          <path class="leaf-shape sleeping" data-leaf-grow d="M175 113C124 92 116 45 134 23c51 6 59 46 41 90Z"/><path class="pot-rim" d="M126 320h140c13 0 18 18 7 26H119c-11-9-6-26 7-26Z"/><path class="pot" d="M125 342h143l-24 91H151l-26-91Z"/><path fill="#95563e" opacity=".4" d="M128 353h132l-4 10H132Z"/>
          <path d="M156 380c18 16 36 12 47 1" stroke="#dc9b70" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity=".55"/>
        </svg><span class="lab__ambient" id="plantCaption">little by little.</span>
      </div><div class="lab__app"><div class="lab__app-header"><strong>ROOTED<span style="color:#91a88a;font-size:.4em;vertical-align:top">✳</span></strong><span class="tag">Interactive preview / sample only</span></div><h3>Today's little rituals.</h3><p class="lab__app-description">Try tending to these three plants. Watch your little jungle respond.</p><div class="lab__counter"><div class="lab__count"><strong id="taskCount">0</strong> of 3 complete</div><div class="lab__meter"><div class="lab__meter-fill" id="taskMeter"></div></div></div>
        <div class="task-list" id="taskList"><button type="button" class="task" aria-pressed="false"><span class="task__check"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3"><path d="m4 12 5 5L20 6"/></svg></span><span class="task__text"><strong>Water the Monstera</strong><small>A little drink goes a long way</small></span><span class="task__icon" aria-hidden="true">◉</span></button>
          <button type="button" class="task" aria-pressed="false"><span class="task__check"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3"><path d="m4 12 5 5L20 6"/></svg></span><span class="task__text"><strong>Check the Pothos light</strong><small>Bright, indirect and just right</small></span><span class="task__icon" aria-hidden="true">☼</span></button>
          <button type="button" class="task" aria-pressed="false"><span class="task__check"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3"><path d="m4 12 5 5L20 6"/></svg></span><span class="task__text"><strong>Note a new leaf</strong><small>Every little change is worth keeping</small></span><span class="task__icon" aria-hidden="true">✳</span></button></div>
        <div class="lab__app-bottom"><p id="taskStatus" role="status" aria-live="polite">A little care starts here.</p><button class="lab__reset" id="resetDemo">Reset the routine ↺</button></div>
      </div></div>
    </div></section>

    <section class="guides" id="guides" aria-labelledby="guidesTitle"><div class="section-width"><div class="guides__head"><div class="reveal"><div class="eyebrow">03 / Always learning</div><h2 id="guidesTitle">Every leaf is<br>a little lesson.</h2></div><p class="reveal">No two plants need quite the same thing. Explore some gentle starting points, and find what makes yours thrive.</p></div>
      <div class="guide-grid">
        <button class="guide-card reveal" data-guide="light"><span class="guide-card__top"><span>01 / THE LIGHT</span><span>✦</span></span><div class="guide-card__art"><svg viewBox="0 0 300 160" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="158" cy="77" r="47" fill="#e4e4bc"/><circle cx="158" cy="77" r="30" fill="#e9d898"/><g stroke="#b3b98b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M158 8v18m0 101v18M88 77h18m104 0h18m-119-49 13 13m73 73 13 13m0-99-13 13m-73 73-13 13"/></g><path class="draw-line" d="M70 154c32-33 52-32 89-22s67-9 93-32" stroke="#5d8661" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div><h3>Find the right light.</h3><p>From gentle morning sun to a cozy shaded corner.</p><span class="guide-card__arrow" aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>
        <button class="guide-card reveal" data-guide="water"><span class="guide-card__top"><span>02 / THE WATER</span><span>✦</span></span><div class="guide-card__art"><svg viewBox="0 0 300 160" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M151 19C132 47 106 73 106 103a45 45 0 0 0 90 0c0-30-26-56-45-84Z" fill="#a7c7bd" stroke="#6d9d90" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M129 108c0 13 9 21 22 21" stroke="#e6f5e7" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><path class="draw-line" d="M40 130c20-32 44-38 60-22m108 0c20 12 36 9 56-13" stroke="#5d8661" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div><h3>Water with care.</h3><p>A little less guessing. A little more confidence.</p><span class="guide-card__arrow" aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>
        <button class="guide-card reveal" data-guide="growth"><span class="guide-card__top"><span>03 / THE GROWTH</span><span>✦</span></span><div class="guide-card__art"><svg viewBox="0 0 300 160" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M150 140V25" stroke="#5e8755" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M149 97C105 95 87 70 100 49c33 0 52 23 49 48ZM151 73c33-4 55-25 48-43-30 1-48 19-48 43Z" fill="#729a6c"/><path d="M151 141c-31-5-46-17-54-31m55-8c21-19 47-22 56-29" stroke="#638d64" stroke-width="3"/><path class="draw-line" d="M56 152c55-24 133-26 185-8" stroke="#b6a578" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div><h3>Celebrate the small.</h3><p>Because growth is a beautiful thing to notice.</p><span class="guide-card__arrow" aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>
      </div></div></section>

    <section class="breath" aria-labelledby="breathTitle" id="community"><img class="breath__img" id="breathImage" src="data:image/webp;base64," loading="lazy" alt="Peaceful indoor plants in terracotta pots with delicate leaf shadows on a warm ivory wall"/><div class="breath__wash" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="breath__copy section-width"><div class="reveal"><div class="eyebrow">A gentler pace</div><h2 id="breathTitle">Real growth<br>isn't rushed.</h2></div></div></section>

    <section class="faq" id="questions" aria-labelledby="faqTitle"><div class="section-width faq__grid"><div class="reveal"><span class="eyebrow">04 / A few questions</span><h2 id="faqTitle">Good things<br>take time.</h2><p class="faq__lead">Plant care doesn't have to be perfect.       <div class="faq__item"><button class="faq__question" aria-expanded="false"><span>What can I track with ROOTED?</span><span class="faq__plus" aria-hidden="true">+</span></button><div class="faq__answer"><div><p>ROOTED's concept experience focuses on watering routines, light checks, individual plant profiles, growth notes, and small everyday milestones.</p></div></div></div>
      <div class="faq__item"><button class="faq__question" aria-expanded="false"><span>Does it work for new plant owners?</span><span class="faq__plus" aria-hidden="true">+</span></button><div class="faq__answer"><div><p>That's who the concept is designed for.     <section class="final" id="download" aria-labelledby="finalTitle"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," loading="lazy" class="final__image" alt="A collection of leafy houseplants beside a pale sage circle"/><div class="final__copy"><div class="reveal"><span class="eyebrow">Ready to grow together?</span><h2 id="finalTitle">Your jungle,<br>gently organized.</h2><p>A thoughtful home for the little routines, growing moments and green companions that make your space yours.</p><button class="button magnet" data-download>Explore the ROOTED concept <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></div></div></section>

  <dialog id="downloadDialog" aria-labelledby="downloadDialogTitle"><div class="modal"><div class="modal__top"><span class="modal__badge">ROOTED / Concept preview</span><button class="modal__close" data-close-dialog aria-label="Close dialog">×</button></div><h2 id="downloadDialogTitle">A little greener starts here.</h2><p>ROOTED is a fictional app concept created as an interactive landing-page showcase. There isn't a real iOS or Android download yet, but you can try the live plant-care routine right here.</p><div class="modal__actions"><button class="button" id="modalDemo">Try the interactive routine ↗</button><button class="line-button" data-close-dialog>Keep exploring</button></div></div></dialog>
  <dialog id="guideDialog" aria-labelledby="guideDialogTitle"><div class="modal"><div class="modal__top"><span class="modal__badge" id="guideDialogTag">ROOTED / Care guides</span><button class="modal__close" data-close-dialog aria-label="Close dialog">×</button></div><h2 id="guideDialogTitle">Find the right light.</h2><p id="guideDialogBody"></p><div class="modal__actions"><button class="button" data-close-dialog>Got it ✓</button></div></div></dialog>
  <script>
    (()=>{
      'use strict';
      const $=(sel,ctx=document)=>ctx.querySelector(sel);
      const $$=(sel,ctx=document)=>Array.from(ctx.querySelectorAll(sel));
      const clamp=(v,min=0,max=1)=>Math.min(max,Math.max(min,v));
      const reduceMotion=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      let reduced=reduceMotion.matches;
      reduceMotion.addEventListener?.('change',e=>{reduced=e.matches;});
      const header=$('#header'), progress=$('#scrollProgress'), hero=$('#heroArt'), breath=$('#breathImage'), story=$('#features');
      let rafQueued=false,activeStory=-1,lastStory=-1;
      const storyButtons=$$('[data-story-step]'),storyImgs=$$('[data-story-image]'),storyPanels=$$('[data-story-panel]');
      const progressBars=$$('.story__progress i');
      const labels=['The daily ritual','Every new leaf','Space to grow'];
      function setStory(index){
        index=Math.max(0,Math.min(2,index));
        if(index===activeStory)return;
        lastStory=activeStory;activeStory=index;
        storyImgs.forEach((el,i)=>{el.classList.toggle('is-active',i===index);el.classList.toggle('is-prev',i===lastStory&&i!==index);});
        storyPanels.forEach((el,i)=>el.classList.toggle('is-active',i===index));
        storyButtons.forEach((el,i)=>{el.classList.toggle('is-active',i===index);if(i===index)el.setAttribute('aria-current','step');else el.removeAttribute('aria-current');});
        $('#storyNumber').textContent=String(index+1).padStart(2,'0');
        $('#storyProgressText').textContent=String(index+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / 03';
        $('#storyImageTag').textContent=labels[index];
        // The latest incoming image takes precedence; old images remain beneath for a mask reveal.
        storyImgs.forEach((img,i)=>{img.style.zIndex=i===index?'3':(i===lastStory?'2':'1');});
      }
      storyButtons.forEach((button,i)=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{
        if(window.matchMedia('(max-width:800px)').matches){setStory(i);return;}
        const travel=Math.max(1,story.offsetHeight-innerHeight);
        const target=story.getBoundingClientRect().top+window.scrollY+travel*(i+.48)/3;
        window.scrollTo({top:target,behavior:reduced?'auto':'smooth'});
      }));
      function updateScroll(){
        rafQueued=false;
        const doc=document.documentElement;const max=Math.max(1,doc.scrollHeight-innerHeight);
        progress.style.width=(scrollY/max*100)+'%';
        header.classList.toggle('is-scrolled',scrollY>30);
        if(!reduced && innerWidth>800){
          const rect=hero.getBoundingClientRect();if(rect.bottom>0 && rect.top<innerHeight){hero.style.transform=`translate3d(0,${Math.round(scrollY*.12)}px,0) scale(1.025)`;}
        } else hero.style.transform='';
        if(innerWidth>800){
          const rect=story.getBoundingClientRect(), travel=Math.max(1,story.offsetHeight-innerHeight);
          const p=clamp(-rect.top/travel);
          setStory(Math.min(2,Math.floor(p*3)));
          progressBars.forEach((el,i)=>{el.style.width=`${clamp(p*3-i)*100}%`;});
        } else {progressBars.forEach((el,i)=>{el.style.width=i<=activeStory?'100%':'0%';});if(activeStory<0)setStory(0);}
        if(!reduced){
          const r=breath.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.bottom>0&&r.top<innerHeight){const p=clamp((innerHeight-r.top)/(innerHeight+r.height));breath.style.transform=`translate3d(0,${(p-.5)*56}px,0) scale(1.03)`;}
        }
        const intro=$('#introduction').getBoundingClientRect();const draw=$('[data-draw]');if(draw){const p=clamp((innerHeight-intro.top)/(innerHeight+intro.height));draw.style.strokeDashoffset=800*(1-p);}
      }
      function queueScroll(){if(!rafQueued){rafQueued=true;requestAnimationFrame(updateScroll);}}
      window.addEventListener('scroll',queueScroll,{passive:true});window.addEventListener('resize',queueScroll,{passive:true});
      setStory(0);updateScroll();
      // Reveal once, while keeping the third guide and all subsections reachable on scroll.
      const reveals=$$('.reveal,.guide-card');
      if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
        const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('is-visible');obs.unobserve(e.target);}});},{rootMargin:'0px 0px -10% 0px',threshold:.1});
        reveals.forEach(el=>obs.observe(el));
      }else reveals.forEach(el=>el.classList.add('is-visible'));
      // Small, bounded magnetic pointer pull; no global cursor replacement.
      if(matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').matches){
        $$('.magnet').forEach(el=>{let active=false;el.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(reduced)return;const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const x=((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5)*10,y=((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5)*8;el.style.transform=`translate3d(${x}px,${y}px,0)`;active=true;});el.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{if(active){el.style.transform='translate3d(0,0,0)';active=false;}});});
        $$('.guide-card').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(reduced)return;const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;el.style.transform=`perspective(950px) rotateX(${(-y*3).toFixed(2)}deg) rotateY(${(x*4).toFixed(2)}deg) translateY(-3px)`;el.style.setProperty('--mx',Math.round((x+.5)*100)+'%');el.style.setProperty('--my',Math.round((y+.5)*100)+'%');}));
        $$('.guide-card').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{el.style.transform='';}));
      }
      // Genuine local interactivity: care tasks and the SVG plant respond to completed tasks.
      const tasks=$$('#taskList .task'),growLeaves=$$('[data-leaf-grow]');
      function syncTasks(){const total=tasks.filter(t=>t.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true').length;$('#taskCount').textContent=total;$('#taskMeter').style.width=(total/3*100)+'%';$('#plantMood').textContent=total===3?'THRIVING':'GROWING WITH YOU';$('#plantCaption').textContent=total===3?'look how far you\'ve grown.':total===0?'little by little.':'one leaf at a time.';$('#taskStatus').textContent=total===3?'All three rituals complete. Your little jungle thanks you.':total===0?'A little care starts here.':`${total} of 3 little rituals complete.`;growLeaves.forEach((leaf,i)=>leaf.classList.toggle('sleeping',i>=total));}
      tasks.forEach(task=>task.addEventListener('click',()=>{task.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(task.getAttribute('aria-pressed')!=='true'));if(!reduced){const dot=document.createElement('i');dot.className='lab__pulse';task.appendChild(dot);dot.addEventListener('animationend',()=>dot.remove(),{once:true});}syncTasks();}));
      $('#resetDemo').addEventListener('click',()=>{tasks.forEach(t=>t.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'));syncTasks();});syncTasks();
      // Accessible local informational dialogs; no false store downloads.
      const downloadDialog=$('#downloadDialog'),guideDialog=$('#guideDialog');let previousFocus=null;
      function openDialog(dialog){previousFocus=document.activeElement;if(typeof dialog.showModal==='function')dialog.showModal();else dialog.setAttribute('open','');}
      function closeDialog(dialog){if(dialog.open)dialog.close();previousFocus?.focus?.();}
      $$('[data-download]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{closeMobile();openDialog(downloadDialog);}));
      $$('[data-close-dialog]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>closeDialog(btn.closest('dialog'))));
      [downloadDialog,guideDialog].forEach(dialog=>{dialog.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===dialog)closeDialog(dialog)});dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>previousFocus?.focus?.());});
      $('#modalDemo').addEventListener('click',()=>{closeDialog(downloadDialog);$('#demo').scrollIntoView({behavior:reduced?'auto':'smooth'});});
      const guideContent={light:{title:'A little light goes a long way.',body:'Most indoor plants enjoy bright, indirect light, but each species has its own preferences. Observe your plant and try moving it gradually rather than making abrupt changes.'},water:{title:'Water when the soil is ready.',body:'Many common houseplants prefer that the top layer of soil dry a little between waterings. Check the soil rather than relying only on the calendar, and make sure excess water can drain.'},growth:{title:'Notice every new leaf.',body:'Small changes are worth celebrating. Keep photos, track growth over time, and pay attention to changes in color, new shoots, and where your plant seems happiest.'}};
      $$('[data-guide]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const guide=guideContent[btn.dataset.guide];$('#guideDialogTag').textContent='ROOTED / '+btn.dataset.guide.toUpperCase();$('#guideDialogTitle').textContent=guide.title;$('#guideDialogBody').textContent=guide.body;openDialog(guideDialog);}));
      // Accordion has real expanded state; opening one closes the others.
      $$('.faq__question').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const shouldOpen=btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true';$$('.faq__question').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'));btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(shouldOpen));}));
      const menuBtn=$('#menuButton'),menu=$('#mobileNav');function closeMobile(){menu.classList.remove('is-open');menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-label','Open navigation');}
      menuBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const isOpen=menu.classList.toggle('is-open');menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(isOpen));menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-label',isOpen?'Close navigation':'Open navigation');});
      $$('#mobileNav a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',closeMobile));
      document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeMobile()});
      document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(menu.classList.contains('is-open')&&!menu.contains(e.target)&&!menuBtn.contains(e.target))closeMobile();});
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
